pages.quiz:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #13
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. How many months are in the Indian traditional calendar year? (1 mark)
   A. Seven
   B. Ten
   C. Twelve
   D. Fifteen

2. Which practice is part of Paryushan? (1 mark)
   A. Shouting
   B. Cheating
   C. Fasting
   D. Hunting

3. What should we never throw into rivers? (1 mark)
   A. Plastic and waste
   B. Rain
   C. Rainwater
   D. Clean leaves

4. What is a rite or ritual? (1 mark)
   A. A river
   B. A special action done in a set way at a festival
   C. A kind of food
   D. A school subject

5. Which planet is called the red planet? (1 mark)
   A. Mars
   B. Venus
   C. Jupiter
   D. Saturn

6. What does Param mean in Paramatma? (1 mark)
   A. New
   B. Small
   C. Highest
   D. Quiet

7. What is the Panchang? (1 mark)
   A. A prayer
   B. A river
   C. A kind of tree
   D. The Indian traditional calendar book

8. What was the name of Siddhartha's father? (1 mark)
   A. King Dasharatha
   B. Hiranyakashipu
   C. King Suddhodana
   D. Guru Amar Das

9. What does Asteya mean? (1 mark)
   A. Do not take what is not given
   B. Sit still
   C. Fast all day
   D. Sing every day

10. At what time of day did Narsimha appear in the story? (1 mark)
   A. At sunrise
   B. In the evening, between day and night
   C. At noon
   D. At midnight

11. What should Amina do about the extra money? (1 mark)
   A. Keep it
   B. Return the extra to the shopkeeper
   C. Give it away
   D. Spend it

12. A child promises to return a friend's book on time. Which scripture lesson is being followed? (1 mark)
   A. Not stealing, as in Rijubalika
   B. Keeping a promise, as in the Ramayan
   C. Sitting on heels
   D. Making a fast

13. How should we behave when the National Anthem is sung? (1 mark)
   A. Talk
   B. Run about
   C. Play
   D. Stand straight and be quiet

14. Which is a mistake in yoga? (1 mark)
   A. Working with a teacher
   B. Breathing slowly
   C. Stopping if unwell
   D. Holding the breath for too long

15. On which date did Kenya become fully independent? (1 mark)
   A. 1 June 1963
   B. 12 December 1963
   C. 21 June 2015
   D. 1 January 1964

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. What does the word Panch Mahabhoot mean? (2 marks)

17. Give two safety rules for yoga. (2 marks)

18. Name two parts of a Mandir. (2 marks)

19. Explain the meaning of karma. (3 marks)

20. What is a festival? (2 marks)

21. Name two grahas in the traditional calendar that are not planets in modern science. (2 marks)

22. Give the meaning of Maha Shivratri. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #13 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — Twelve
   It has twelve months.

2. C — Fasting
   Fasting, prayer and charity.

3. A — Plastic and waste
   Waste harms water and living things.

4. B — A special action done in a set way at a festival
   Examples are lighting a lamp or raising a flag.

5. A — Mars
   Mars is the red planet.

6. C — Highest
   Param means highest.

7. D — The Indian traditional calendar book
   It lists days, months and festival dates.

8. C — King Suddhodana
   Siddhartha's father was King Suddhodana.

9. A — Do not take what is not given
   Asteya means not stealing.

10. B — In the evening, between day and night
   It was neither day nor night but the time between.

11. B — Return the extra to the shopkeeper
   Integrity means giving it back.

12. B — Keeping a promise, as in the Ramayan
   Ram kept promises.

13. D — Stand straight and be quiet
   We show respect.

14. D — Holding the breath for too long
   Never force the breath.

15. B — 12 December 1963
   Jamhuri Day is 12 December.

SECTION B
----
16. (2 marks)
   Answer: Five great elements.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for five and 1 mark for great elements.

17. (2 marks)
   Answer: Practise with a teacher, wear loose clothes, do it on a mat, do not do it after a big meal, stop if you feel dizzy (any two).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

18. (2 marks)
   Answer: Entrance, main hall, inner room (garbhagriha), spire (shikhara), bell (any two).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

19. (3 marks)
   Answer: Karma means action. Good actions bring good results and unkind actions bring trouble.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for action, 1 mark for good, 1 mark for unkind.

20. (2 marks)
   Answer: A special day or set of days when people come together to remember something important.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for special day and 1 mark for remembering or celebrating together.

21. (2 marks)
   Answer: The Sun and the Moon.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

22. (2 marks)
   Answer: The great night of Lord Shiva.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for great night and 1 mark for Shiva.
